usageGuidelines: Use after the user names a product and wants an evidence-preserving market-state label instead of raw factor rows.
Check the calculation-history tool when the user needs the underlying factor evidence first.
Never summarize the label as a trade call; preserve the boundary that SPECTRA is interpretation over factor history.

description: Use this read-only tool to retrieve the market SPECTRA field map for one Coinbase INTX perp product. It converts persisted market-factor history into field pressure, stored energy, compression, release, and current_read labels while preserving the underlying numeric factor evidence. Parameters: product is required; optional source_date or source_date_from/source_date_to, limit, and offset. Behavior: read-only and idempotent with no destructive side effects; it does not create factors, reconstruct missing depth, or override the underlying factor rows.

limit.description: Maximum factor-history points to include before SPECTRA assembly. Defaults to 25 and is capped at 100 through MCP.

offset.description: Pagination offset over the factor-history points used for the field map.

product.description: Required Coinbase INTX product_id or contract_symbol, for example AI-PERP-INTX.

source_date.description: Optional exact source date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

source_date_from.description: Optional inclusive source-date lower bound in YYYY-MM-DD format.

source_date_to.description: Optional inclusive source-date upper bound in YYYY-MM-DD format.

name: deltasignal_coinbase_perp_market_spectra

source_date.description: Latest source date represented in the field map.
